status: OF-RECORD (locked). Bridge deployed operating point under the EAP-posterior stop.

provenance.grid_source: experiments/13_eap_stop_grid/ (Phase-A EAP floor x SE grid + tail stats)
provenance.superseded: the online-SE @0.15 grid is archived at experiments/archive_onlineSE/06b_operating_point/

why_0.12_not_0.15: The SE target is a TAIL-precision guarantee, not a median lever: on Bridge's heavy ~18-criterion testlets the median model is already below any target once the floor is met, so se_total_median is ~flat across SE targets. Because SE_total adds SE_param (~0.05), an SE-ability target of 0.15 still leaves 14 models with SE_total > 0.15 (max 0.203); tightening to 0.12 collapses that tail to 2 (max 0.195), at the cost of mean deployed length 14 -> 17 scenarios. 0.12 also aligns Bridge's SE target with the WildBench / BiGGen adoptions.
why_eap_not_online: The online normal-approx SE stop is optimistic at boundary / low-information theta and declares the tail 'converged' prematurely; under the online rule the SE target below 0.15 barely acts on the tail. The EAP posterior SD stop integrates the honest posterior over the fine theta grid, so tightening the SE target actually pulls the tail in. Adopting EAP also resolves the online-vs-posterior estimator mismatch (deployment scores MWLE / posterior).
note_on_recovery_r: recovery_r is the OOS k-fold measure (fold-refit params); scenarios_* / se_total_* are the DEPLOYED frozen-bank measures. The two conventions differ by design and are not directly comparable across panels. See recovery_grid.csv for the full 7x7 grid and recovery_grid_tailstats.csv for tail-aware per-cell SE.
